books.title: The Great Illusion
books.author: Norman Angell
books.summary: A philosopher and M.P. argues that the financial and commercial interdependence of modern nations renders military conquest economically futile and traditional empire-building self-defeating.

books.title: The Defiant Agents
books.author: Andre Norton
books.summary: Rival colonies are stranded on an alien world, their memories mixed with those of their ancestors and pitted against each other by the Western and Soviet forces who sent them.

books.title: The Diary
books.author: Samuel Pepys
books.summary: The diary of a man living in London in the 17th century.

books.title: Personal Recollections of Joan of Arc
books.author: Mark Twain
books.summary: A fictional biography of Joan of Arc from her early teenage years to her martyrdom.

books.title: The Wind in the Willows
books.author: Kenneth Grahame
books.summary: Four animals adventure through the bucolic English countryside.

books.title: Hay Fever
books.author: Noël Coward
books.summary: A well-to-do family cannot be civil to each other in front of their weekend guests.

books.title: Agamemnon
books.author: Aeschylus
books.summary: The titular Greek king returns home from the Trojan war to be greeted by his scheming wife, who plots vengeance.

books.title: The Story of the Amulet

books.summary: Four children are reunited with an ancient, magical creature and go on adventures through time with a magic amulet.

books.title: Fantômas

books.title: Recollections of Full Years

books.title: What Is Art?
books.author: Leo Tolstoy
books.summary: Leo Tolstoy outlines his philosophy of aesthetics.

books.title: The Consolation of Philosophy
books.author: Boethius
books.summary: A Roman statesman awaiting execution is visited by the personification of philosophy.

books.title: A Woman of No Importance
books.author: Oscar Wilde

books.title: A Strange Manuscript Found in a Copper Cylinder

books.title: Short Fiction

books.summary: A collection of short fiction by Tanizaki Jun’ichirō, ordered by date of original publication.

books.title: The Pilgrim’s Progress
